name: JEU DE CARTE SIPA
description: Jeu de Carte Sipa (or simply Sipa) is a popular trick-taking game in Togo and across West Africa. It is a variant of the regional game 'Spar'. The game is fast-paced and revolves around the critical importance of the final trick. The ultimate goal is to win the last trick(s), specifically with a 7, which provides significantly higher points.

content.text: Jeu de Carte Sipa (or simply Sipa) is a popular trick-taking game in Togo and across West Africa. It is a variant of the regional game 'Spar'. The game is fast-paced and revolves around the critical importance of the final trick. The ultimate goal is to win the last trick(s), specifically with a 7, which provides significantly higher points.

Derived from 'Spar', which has roots in Dutch or Portuguese card traditions brought to the West African coast. It has adapted into a unique social game played in Togo, particularly in rural villages during the dry season.
35 cards: A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6. **Note**: The Ace of Spades is usually removed, making the King of Spades the highest spade.
